what: Console-created account has no password, cannot ever log in
walk: OH POST /api/org/users -> 201, body carries no password, no invite, no token. POST /api/auth/login with that email, three passwords -> 401 each. ZM/CSM/WM POST /api/org/users -> 403 (check 6 v). Five not-found checks: auth controller exposes only login/refresh/logout; the only userCredential.create is auth/credential-seed.ts:21 with seed-only callers; grep invite|reset-password|set-password|activation across apps/backend/src returns 0 product hits; terminology check found LoginPage.tsx:162 Forgot Password? rendered as an anchor with href=# (dead control, no handler); no entry point in any other module.
policyClause: invite/first-password flow is a product decision, not just a hash write; the self-service escape hatch is a dead link too

what: No reader can see what a config dial changed FROM and TO
walk: OH POST /api/ops-explorer/datasets/auditLogs/query search=SETTING -> 200 with 3 rows (SE_ASSIGNMENT_THRESHOLD_UPDATED on se_assignment_threshold_hours, two SETTING_UPDATED on eligibility_mode). Every row shows action, entityType, entityId, actorId, actorRole, createdAt and nothing else. TWO independent causes, not one: settings.service.ts setUnchecked passes no metadata at all, AND dataset-registry.ts AUDIT_LOGS projects no metadata column, so even assignment-threshold.service.ts:224 previousHours/newHours - which IS written correctly - is unreadable through the only lens that exists. schema.prisma:1729 audit_logs.metadata Json? exists and is wasted.
policyClause: S3 upgrade: the reader omits the column too, so the fix is two files not one

what: NOT A GAP - ZM genuinely cannot write the threshold
walk: ZM PUT /api/settings/assignment-threshold with hours 48, the CURRENT value, deliberately inert -> 403. WM PUT -> 403. ZM GET -> 200 (read-only by design, per the controller docstring: the ZM is the graded party). WM GET -> 403, SE GET -> 403. static.md row 48 attributing ZONAL_MANAGER to the PUT is a scanner defect (O4-b, guard column off by one decorator): the class @Roles(OPERATIONS_HEAD, CENTRAL_SERVICE_MANAGER) governs and ZM appears only on the @Get. Separation of duties on this dial HOLDS.

what: NOT A GAP - check 6 clean across 32 config write probes
walk: 24 probes (ZM, CSM, WM against POST org/plants, PUT org/sla-rules, POST org/scoring-weights, POST org/common-kit, POST org/zones, POST org/users, POST org/se-coverage, PUT org/plant-zone-overrides) returned 403 every one. Plus ZM/CSM/WM/SE against POST /api/plants/1/deactivate -> 403 and PUT /api/settings/<key> -> 403. Empty-body probes were used deliberately: a 400 would have proved the role got past RoleGuard without mutating anything. Nothing got past. The module write surface is genuinely OH-fenced, with the threshold PUT additionally opened to CSM.

what: Snapshot carries effective value; fresh-read half unproven
walk: CONFIRMED half: GET /api/dispatch-runs/36 as OH returns configSnapshot.settings = dispatch_cron, eligibility_mode, plant_cluster_multiplier, inactivity_threshold_hours, se_assignment_threshold_hours 48; GET /api/settings/assignment-threshold returns hours 48. The run snapshot records the EFFECTIVE live value, agreeing with S2 source reading. UNPROVEN half: that a mid-day change is read fresh rather than from an in-process cache - that needs a real threshold write plus a run, and this walker was instructed not to move that dial while other walkers are live. Cost to settle: one PUT, one manual run, one GET, one restoring PUT, roughly 8k TEQ, in an exclusive window.

what: Plant deactivation strips day-plan stops, phone never told
walk: NOT WALKED BY INSTRUCTION - a deactivation would corrupt other live walkers evidence. Read-only support gathered instead: GET /api/plants/deactivations as OH -> 200 with 6 real rows (e.g. plant 128 SCNEL SILCHAR CEMENT, 24 devices, reason citing docs/audits/shutdown-plants-2026-07-13.md), so this path is genuinely exercised in this data and is not a dead feature. The missing enqueue at plant-deactivation.service.ts:229 stands at E2. Cost to settle: deactivate a plant owning at least one BatchAssignmentTicket on todays plan, read DayPlanNotificationOutbox for a matching row, then reactivate. Needs an exclusive window on this backend.

what: Reconciliation tool defaults off; on in this dev box
walk: ops-explorer.config.ts readOpsExplorerConfig: OPS_EXPLORER_ENABLED unset resolves to false, so off-by-default is real in source. On THIS box it is explicitly on - GET /api/ops-explorer/meta as OH -> enabled true, developerMode true. The production env value still cannot be read from here, so the claim about production remains needsCall. The guard contract itself is confirmed: disabled means 404, not 403, so the admin app reads it as feature-absent.
